articles.headline: How fallen giants and their fans bounce back from scandal, relegation
articles.description: Some of Europe's greatest teams have suffered relegation as punishment. So what might lie ahead for Man City?

images.name: Rangers banners [1296x729]
images.caption: Rangers have never fully recovered from being sent to the fourth tier of Scottish football, despite the continued support of their fans.

images.name: Zlatan sad [1296x729]
images.caption: Zlatan Ibrahimovic was one of several Juventus players who left the club in the wake of the Calciopoli scandal.

images.name: Angelo Di Livio [1296x729]
images.caption: Angelo Di Livio chose to remain with Fiorentina despite their relegation, and remains a club legend to this day as a result.

articles.headline: Celtic inflict painful lesson on Hearts with 7-1 thrashing at Parkhead
articles.description: Callum Osmand was on target again as Celtic inflicted more misery on Hearts with a 7-1 thrashing at Parkhead.

images.name: Callum Osmand [1296x729]
images.caption: Callum Osmand scored a brace as Celtic inflicted a painful lesson on Hearts as Parkhead.

images.name: Benjamin Nygren [1296x729]
images.caption: Benjamin Nygren added a seventh to complete the rout.
images.credit: Photo by Craig Williamson/SNS Group via Getty Images

articles.headline: Celtic condemn protest after tennis balls thrown at owner
articles.description: Celtic have condemned the protest which saw tennis balls thrown towards principal shareholder Dermot Desmond during his visit to the Alfred Dunhill Links golf tournament at St Andrews.

images.name: Dermot Desmond [1296x729]
images.credit: Ross Parker/SNS Group via Getty Images

articles.headline: Rangers' Ryan Naderi downs Celtic in Old Firm Derby
articles.description: Ryan Naderi scored the only goal as Rangers defeated Celtic 1-0 at Celtic Park on Sunday.

articles.headline: Celtic vs. Rangers - Kick-off time, how to watch Olwethu Makhanya in South Africa on ESPN and Disney+
articles.description: In a rematch of last Sunday's Old Firm Premier Sports Cup clash, Celtic will face Rangers again this Sunday - this time in the Scottish Premiership at Celtic Park.
